title: MineWatch
description: A watch that tells time and coordinates in Minecraft/在 Minecraft 里看时间和坐标的手表
body:
# MineWatch
## 📖 Overview / 概述  
Tired of pressing F3 to check the time and coordinates? MineWatch gives you a real watch in Minecraft. Can see current in-game time, coordinates and day.  /不想再按 F3 看时间和坐标了？MineWatch 给你一块真正的手表，可以查看当前时间，坐标和天数。

✅ Current in-game time (hour:minute) / 当前游戏内时间（时:分）  
✅ Current day number / 当前是第几天  
✅ 24-hour format (6:00 sunrise, 18:00 sunset) / 24 小时制（6:00 日出，18:00 日落）
✅ Coordinates / 当前坐标

---

## 🎮 How to Use / 怎么用  
Just put MineWatch in your inventory./只需将MineWatch放在你的物品栏即可

The time will appear on your screen like: / 屏幕上会显示例如：

![Show Time Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b755e6916e79fdf29e3511398cea2448ad7f0304.png)

![Show Coordinates Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f2d352dc89530e317adc4c40415cb104ab3b391.png)

Use this item to toggle the display content (Hidden -> Time -> Coordinates) / 使用此物品以切换显示内容（隐藏 -> 时间 -> 坐标）

---

## 🔧 Crafting Recipe / 合成配方

|     |     |     |
|-----|-----|-----|
|     | Redstone  |     |
| Redstone  | Clock  | Redstone  |
|     | Redstone  |     |

- Clock / 钟  
- Redstone / 红石

---

## 📦 Installation / 安装

**Minecraft Version**: 1.21.8 – 1.21.11
**Loader**: Fabric

1. Download the `.jar` file / 下载 `.jar` 文件  
2. Put it into `.minecraft/mods` / 放入 `.minecraft/mods` 文件夹  
3. Launch the game / 启动游戏
